messages:
Noah Kim: Quick idea - introduce an "ownership lease" for postmortem followups. short lease = clearer handoffs, fewer stale cards.

Zara Khan: sounds promising. what lengths are you thinking?

Noah Kim: defaults: P0/P1 = 7 days, P2 = 14 days. owner must post an update every 48h or escalation triggers. lightweight handoff template included below.

Diego Ruiz: can we require a one-line success metric in the followup? helps close the loop.

Noah Kim: yes - add `success_metric` to the template. also add an "owner history" line so we can compute churn.

Zara Khan: also suggest an IC rotation tweak: 2-week rotation and a 3-bullet handoff checklist when IC changes. keeps context.

status-bot: Followup created -> FUP-7890 (owner: Noah Kim). TTL: 7d. Escalation: 48h without update.

Diego Ruiz: small UX ask - pin the followup link in the incident thread and add a one-line summary. adoption is much higher with that pin.

Noah Kim: agreed. Proposed next steps: (1) add lease + template to runbook (Noah) - PR within 48h; (2) wire status-bot to set TTL & escalate (Diego) - spike 5d; (3) trial on next two high-priority incidents (Zara) - start this sprint.

Zara Khan: +1, i'll coordinate the trial and metrics to track (closure within TTL, churn, recurrence hits).

Noah Kim: thanks everyone, will open the PR now. :rocket:
